extracted.name: Red Death Cocktail
extracted.description: This drink is a sure winner for all, but watch out its will catch up to you quick!
instruction_lines: Pour the sloe gin, Southern Comfort, vodka, rum, triple sec, amaretto, Galliano, grenadine, and orange juice into a cocktail shaker over ice. Cover, and shake until the outside of the shaker has frosted. Strain into a tumbler filled with ice.
